headlines.title: Why Fed Inflation Rate May Fall; ADP Jobs Report On Tap (Live Coverage)
headlines.summary: The Federal Reserve's primary inflation rate is due out at 8:30 a.m. ET, and don't be surprised if the core PCE price index shows a significant slowdown in price increases over the 12 months through August vs. the initial report for July.  Wall Street expects the overall PCE price index to rise 0.4% on the month, leaving the 12-month headline inflation rate at 3.7%.

headlines.title: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Heads Into Earnings With Its Valuation Still In Focus
headlines.summary: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) is back on investors’ radar as the company prepares to report first quarter fiscal 2027 results before the Nasdaq opens on October 28, 2026. Attention now shifts to what management says on the accompanying call. Recent trading has been choppy for Automatic Data Processing, with the share price down 8.93% over the past month but still showing a 16.90% 90 day share price return. The 1 year total shareholder return is down 7.

description: Automatic Data Processing, Inc. provides cloud-based human capital management (HCM) solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Employer Services and Professional Employer Organization (PEO). The Employer Services segment offers strategic, cloud-based platforms, and human resources (HR) outsourcing solutions. This segment's offerings include RUN Powered by ADP, a software platform for small business payroll, HR, and compliance; ADP Workforce Now, a HCM solution used across mid-sized and large businesses to manage employees; and ADP Lyric HCM, a solution for HR management, payroll, workforce management, talent, and data analytics. Its PEO Services segment provides HR outsourcing solutions under ADP TotalSource name to businesses through a co-employment model. This segment also provides guidance, user-friendly technology, comprehensive employee benefits, and a risk management, safety, and workers' compensation program. The company was founded in 1949 and is headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
